title: Optimized electroporation of CRISPR-Cas9/gRNA ribonucleoprotein complex for selection-free homologous recombination in human pluripotent stem cells
protocol: Passage iPSCs one or two days before electroporation at high cell density.
Prepare 2.5 μg of iMatrix-511 diluted in 2 mL of PBS for coating wells.
Coat wells with prepared iMatrix-511 mixture at 37°C for at least 2 h in a humidified CO2 incubator.
Wash iPSCs with 2 mL of PBS once and remove PBS.
Add 0.5 mL of Accutase to the well.
Rock the plate every 3–4 min to ensure Accutase covers cells homogeneously in the well.
Incubate the plate at 37°C for 10 min.
Pipette cells up and down in Accutase solution with a 1000 μL pipette tip to detach cells from the plate.
Suspend cells by pipetting while in the Accutase mixture to ensure proper dissociation.
Transfer cell suspension to a new 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube containing 0.9 mL of StemFit media.
Centrifuge cell suspension at 120 × g for 5 min.
Aspirate supernatant.
Resuspend cells with 1 mL of StemFit media containing 10 μM Y-27632 by gentle pipetting.
Count cells and check cell viability by trypan blue staining.
Plate 1.5 × 10^6 cells of live iPSCs in the pre-coated iMatrix-511 plate in 2 mL of StemFit media containing 10 μM Y-27632.
Incubate plate in a CO2 incubator at 37°C for one day.
Turn on the laptop PC connected to the MaxCyte ATx electroporation instrument at least 10 min before electroporation.
Log into the laptop PC and turn on the ATx instrument.
Click the ATx shortcut icon on the Windows desktop.
Select desired protocol for the experiment.
Select the OC-100 processing assembly from the processing assembly dropdown menu.
Aspirate the coating buffer from each well.
Add 2 mL of StemFit media containing 10 μM Y-27632 to each well.
Incubate in a CO2 incubator at 37°C for pre-warming the media until finishing the dissociation of iPSCs.
Add 1 mL of MaxCyte HyClone Buffer to the cell pellet.
Pipette up and down gently to dissociate and wash the pellet.
Count the cells and check for viability by trypan blue staining.
Centrifuge at 120 × g for 5 min at room temperature.
Aspirate MaxCyte HyClone Buffer.
Resuspend iPSC pellet in MaxCyte HyClone buffer at a cell density of 1 × 10^7 cells/mL, taking into account the volume of the cell pellet itself.
Mix 10 μg of CRISPR-Cas9 protein with 2.5 μg of IVT gRNA in a 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube.
Incubate at room temperature for at least 10 min.
Increase gRNA amount to 2-3 fold (5-7.5 μg) if necessary.
Add 10 μg of ssODN into the Cas9/gRNA complex.
Pipette up and down five times gently in the microcentrifuge tube containing the Cas9/gRNA complex and ssODN solution.
Avoid introducing air bubbles during pipetting.
Transfer the cell mixture to the OC-100 processing assembly slowly but steadily, only going to the first stop of the pipette.
Tap the OC-100 gently to ensure the solution spreads out in the processing assembly.
Avoid introducing air bubbles during the transfer process.
Remove any air bubbles using a 10 μL pipette if they are present.
Ensure your cell suspension solution is evenly distributed, touching both electrodes on the side walls of the cuvette.
Do not leave iPSCs sitting in MaxCyte buffer for an extended period before electroporation.
Mix MaxCyte HyClone buffer with cells and RNP complex, and ssODN if applicable.
Transfer 50 μL of the mixture into the well of OC-100 Processing Assembly chamber.
Close the lid after adding the sample.
Select the desired electroporation protocol (Optimization Energy 8).
Choose the processing assembly (OC-100).
Insert the OC-100 processing assembly and start electroporation.
Press “Start” on the instrument software for the first sample, which takes about 40 seconds to charge up.
Perform actual electroporation, which lasts around 2–3 seconds per sample.
Place the OC-100 into a 37°C humidified CO2 incubator for 20–30 minutes after electroporation.
Transfer cells from the OC-100 to a well of 6-well plate with 2 mL of StemFit media containing 10 μM Y-27632 and pre-coated with iMatrix-511.
Rinse the OC-100 processing assembly with 50 μL of StemFit media (optional).
Add recovered residual cells to the culture vessel after rinsing.
Incubate the cells in 37°C for culturing.
Remove Y-27632 after 1–2 days of transfection.
Dissociate cells after 3–5 days of transfection when they become semi-confluent.
Expand a part of cells to maintain them, make a cell stock or extract genomic DNA.
Make a freeze stock of cells using STEM-CELLBANKER if there are enough cells.
Turn on the 4D-nucleofector instrument.
Choose X unit.
Choose X-16 Strip (or X-single if using Single Nucleocuvette).
Select the wells for transfection.
Set program as CA-137 and P4 primary buffer (or appropriate buffer).
Press “OK” to open tray port.
Proceed with cell preparation.
Prepare mixture of P4 primary buffer, cells, and RNP complex.
Transfer 20 μL of mixture into one well of 16 well strips.
Select wells where samples are located.
Input pulse code CA-137.
Select solution Primary Cell P4.
Insert 16 well strips.
Start electroporation.
Centrifuge at 120 × g for 5 minutes (at room temperature).
Aspirate supernatant.
Add 20 μL of P4 Primary Cell Solution per condition into the cell pellet and gently suspend at room temperature.
If you have 5 conditions, add 100 μL of P4 Primary Cell Solution.
Prepare CRISPR-Cas9 RNP mixture by mixing 5 μg of CRISPR-Cas9 protein with 1.25 μg of IVT gRNA and incubate at room temperature in a 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube.
Add 10 (or 6–12) μg of ssODN as a template for single nucleotide alteration or loxP insertion.
Transfer 20 μL of Cas9/gRNA and ssODN mixture into a well of Nucleocuvette Strip at room temperature.
DO NOT make bubbles.
Avoid air bubbles in the cuvette before electroporation.
Remove any detected air bubble using a P-10 pipette.
Ensure even distribution of the cell suspension solution across both sides of the electrode wall in the cuvette.
Place the Nucleocuvette strip into the 4D-Nucleofector device.
Press “Start” to begin the electroporation process.
After electroporation, add 50–80 μL of StemFit media with Y-27632 into each well of the Nucleocuvette Strip.
Gently pipet up and down several times to mix thoroughly.
Transfer all cells from the Nucleocuvette Strip wells into one well of a pre-coated 6-well plate containing 2 mL of StemFit media with 10 μM Y-27632.
Incubate the cells at 37°C for culturing purposes.
Remove Y-27632 from the culture medium after 1–2 days post-transfection if not necessary longer.
If significant cell death is observed, continue adding Y-27632 to the culture medium until recovery occurs.
Dissociate cells after 4–7 days of transfection when they become semi-confluent.
Extract genomic DNA from the cell pellet using MonoFas gDNA Cultured Cells Extraction Kit VI.
Design PCR primers to amplify the target locus using Primer-blast or Primer3 software.
Amplify the target locus from the genomic sample(s) by PCR, including a non-genome edited sample as a negative control.
Harvest semi-confluent iPSCs from the above section by 0.5 × TrypLE Select.
Coat three 96-well plates with iMatrix-511 at least 1–24 h before cell seeding.
Perform cell dissociation procedures as described in “Preparation of human iPSCs” section 2.b-d.
Count cells using a hemocytometer and trypan blue.
Add 1.0–10.0 × 10^5 live cells in a 1.5 mL tube for sub-cloning by single cell sorting.
Centrifuge at 120 × g for 5 minutes (at room temperature).
Remove supernatant.
Gently resuspend cells in 300 μL of FACS buffer (2% FBS in PBS).
Transfer into a 5 mL flow tube with cell strainer to remove cell clumps.
Sort 1 cell/well of 96-well plate using a cell sorter (e.g., BD FACS Aria II).
Incubate the sorted 96-well plate at 37°C in a CO2 incubator.
Perform the cell dissociation procedures as described in “Preparation of human iPSCs” section 2. b–d.
Count cells using a hemocytometer and trypan blue.
Transfer 1.0 × 10^4 cells into a 15 mL tube with 10 mL of StemFit media containing 10 μM Y-27632.
Further dilute the cell suspension by transferring 10 μL, 30 μL, and 100 μL into three 15 mL tubes with 10 mL of StemFit media and 10 μM Y-27632.
Ensure the final concentration of cells is 10 cells, 30 cells, and 100 cells per 10 mL respectively.
Remove iMatrix coating buffer from the plate prepared in “Day-7–0: Preparation of sub cloning”.
Add 100 μL of cell suspension into one well of a 96-well plate using a multi-channel pipette.
Incubate the plates at 37°C in a 5% CO2 incubator.
Observe each well under a microscope the next day and mark wells with single-cell seeding.
Discard wells containing more than one cell.
Add 50 μL of fresh StemFit media with 10 μM Y-27632 to each well every 2 or 3 days starting from Day 2.
On day 6 or 7, change the medium with StemFit without Y-27632.
Mark wells containing a single colony of iPS cells by day 7–10.
Discard wells if more than two colonies are observed.
Passage all cells from one well of a 96-well plate to one well of a 24-well plate around day 9-11 when iPSC colonies reach 100–300 μm in diameter.
Change media every 2 days until iPSCs become semi-confluent.
Extract genomic DNA from half of the semi-confluent cells using a MonoFas gDNA Cultured Cells Extraction Kit VI or similar kit.
Elute genomic DNA in 40 μL of elution buffer.
Make a vial of freeze stock from the other half of the cells using STEM-CELLBANKER.
Perform PCR amplification of the target region for all isolated subclones.
Conduct Sanger sequencing to assess genome editing efficiency in bulk iPSCs.
Choose subclones containing the expected knockout or knock-in sequence.
Repeat steps a. through e. until desired subclones are identified.
Check protein expression, cellular phenotype, pluripotency test, differentiation capacity, and genomic integrity for selected subclones.
